{{Quote|Those X-wings were like buzz-beetles trying to take down a ronto.|[[Villian Dance]]|<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
'''Buzz-beetles''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Beetle/Legends|beetle]] that afflicted [[Ronto/Legends|rontos]].<ref name="Death Star" /> There was an old [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] expression about being a buzz-beetle on a wall.<ref name="MedStar I">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Den Dhur]] compared the [[moon moth espionage droid]] to the Kubaz expression while he was spying on a conversation between [[Filba]] the Hutt and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tarnese Bleyd]].<ref name="MedStar I" />
